description.hook: Jane Porter has decided to stay in Africa. Six centuries have other plans.
paragraphs: In 1913, Jane is ready to build a life she has chosen for herself. She has loved Tarzan and left him. She has work she wants to do, languages to learn, and a father who will have to get used to her decision.
Then a violent anomaly tears her out of that life.

Jane wakes in a Baltimore transformed beyond recognition. Its technology can do things she scarcely knows how to ask for. Its records have already assigned her a place in history. And the people interested in her arrival have reasons of their own for helping her understand it.
There is work here, too. Friendship. The possibility of love. There may even be a way home.
But Jane has learned how easily a woman’s life can become part of somebody else’s plans. The future will have to make room for hers.
